NER.note: Names a civil register (RNEC) and the RNP but states no exchange of records between them.
No count or share of people enrolled; only timely birth declaration rising from 53% to 79%, which is not all births.
No identity number given at birth is stated.
Future ANEI is to manage the RNP, but no operator or maintainer of a system in service is stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The Interior Ministry said on 12 August 2026 that the Registre National de la Population will become the single base to identify and authenticate each citizen by a personal identifier, with deployment starting in Niamey in the coming weeks and national extension from 2027 under the future ANEI.
